definitions.charging_over_24h: rows whose hh:mm:ss charging duration exceeds 1440 minutes
definitions.delivery_blocks: segments of one file delimited by the per-delivery row id restarting at 0; each compared with the last block on the natural key
definitions.dst_transition_gaps: sessions spanning local 01:00-02:00 on a DST transition date, with (end - start) - recorded duration in minutes
definitions.end_before_start_excluding_sentinel: rows whose parsed end is earlier than start, excluding ends in 1970 (a missing-value sentinel)
definitions.energy_zero: rows whose energy parses to exactly 0
definitions.exact_duplicate_rows: rows identical on every source column to an earlier row (pandas duplicated, first kept)
definitions.idle_share_of_connected_minutes: 1 - sum(charging minutes) / sum(connected minutes) over all rows
definitions.natural_key_duplicate_rows: rows whose natural key repeats an earlier row across all of the source's files
definitions.null_rate: share of rows whose value is null or an empty/whitespace string
definitions.observed_concurrency: after natural-key deduplication, the maximum number of sessions (>= 5 minutes) at one key whose [start, end] intervals overlap; a lower bound on ports in service
definitions.one_hour_gap_rows: rows where (end - start) differs from the recorded duration by 55..65 minutes
definitions.span_over_24h: rows whose parsed end minus start exceeds 1440 minutes

days_at_level.note: per key, distinct local dates on which concurrency reaches the level; robust_max(N) = highest level reached on >= N days

delivery_blocks.note: block i is compared with the last block on the natural key

timezone.dst_note: +60 on spring-forward and -60 on fall-back dates means wall-clock local timestamps; 0 would mean UTC

natural_key_conflicts.note: a zero-duration, zero-energy row beside a real row at the same second is an aborted plug-in; the rule keeps the row with the larger charging time

timezone.note: if the +00:00 offset were really local time mislabelled, the overnight trough would sit at the published hours; if it is true UTC, the trough sits at the converted hours

seasonal_shift.reading: about -1 means the raw hours are true UTC (local habits fixed, UTC hour earlier in summer); about 0 means the raw hours are already local
